# ZacCupples.com

> > Movement coaching and biomechanics education by Zac Cupples, featuring the Human Matrix training system for corrective exercise and pain relief.

Zac Cupples is a physical therapist and movement specialist mentored by Bill Hartman, offering personalized coaching in Las Vegas and teaching Human Matrix seminars nationwide. The site provides evidence-based corrective exercises for common postural and movement dysfunctions, drawing from FMS, PRI, DNS, and other professional development systems.

## Key Topics

- Human Matrix
- Corrective exercises
- Biomechanics
- Movement coaching
- Breathing exercises
- Posture correction
- Mobility training
- Physical therapy
- Pain relief
- Anterior pelvic tilt
- Rib flare
- Bill Hartman
- Movement Debrief
- FMS (Functional Movement Systems)

## Corrective Exercise Guides

- [Fix 90% of Pelvic Tilts in 30 Days](https://zaccupples.com/pelvic-tilts): Hip mobility testing and exercises to correct anterior pelvic tilt
- [Fix Everything in 30 Days](https://zaccupples.com/fix-everything): 5 fundamental mobility moves for ankle, breathing, and rotation issues
- [5 Exercises That Fix 90% of Problems](https://zaccupples.com/5-exercises-90-percent): Core mobility exercises addressing rotation, tension, and movement patterns
- [Fix Rib Flare FAST (In Less Than 5 Minutes a Day)](https://zaccupples.com/fix-rib-flare-fast-in-less-than-5-minutes-a-day): Step-by-step breathing exercises to correct rib flare in 5 minutes daily
- [Uneven Rib Flare – Fix it For Good](https://zaccupples.com/uneven-rib-flare): Guide to fixing asymmetric rib flare through breathing and movement
- [Fix Duck and Pigeon Feet FAST](https://zaccupples.com/fix-duck-and-pigeon-feet-fast): Guide to correcting foot posture through hip rotation mobility exercises
- [The Flat Foot Fix](https://zaccupples.com/flat-foot): Restore foot arch through supination exercises and gait mechanics training
- [20 Second Tight Psoas Release (& Fix Long-Term)](https://zaccupples.com/tight-psoas-release): Quick psoas release technique using breathing and diaphragm mechanics
- [Fix Jaw Pain FAST](https://zaccupples.com/jaw-pain): TMJ exercises for jaw pain relief, grinding, and improved biomechanics
